mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chart_dataset_cache (cache_key, widget_id, dataset, generated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{widgetId}, #{dataset}::jsonb, NOW(), #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET dataset = EXCLUDED.dataset, generated_at = EXCLUDED.generated_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, cache_key, widget_id, dataset::text AS dataset, generated_at, expires_at FROM chart_dataset_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey} AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE chart_dataset_cache SET expires_at = NOW() WHERE cache_key LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND expires_at > NOW()
UPDATE chart_dataset_cache SET expires_at = NOW() WHERE expires_at > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM chart_dataset_cache WHERE expires_at > NOW()
SELECT count(*) FROM chart_dataset_cache WHERE expires_at <= NOW()
